name: Should I remodel my kitchen or build an addition?

mainEntity.name: Should I remodel my kitchen or build an addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: A kitchen addition is often better than a simple remodel when the current footprint is too small to fix with layout changes alone. A remodel may be enough if the room has workable dimensions and only needs new cabinets, surfaces, or fixtures. If you need a larger footprint, an addition is usually the more effective long-term solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a remodel if the room size is already workable; choose an addition if the kitchen is fundamentally too small or too closed off. The right answer depends on the space, not just the finishes.
